clue: Which prophet stretched out his rod over the Red Sea to divide the waters?
fact: Moses led the children of Israel out of Egypt across the parted Red Sea.

clue: In which holy town was Jesus Christ born?
fact: Jesus was born in Bethlehem of Judea, fulfilling the ancient prophecy of Micah.

clue: Which shepherd boy defeated the giant Goliath with a sling and a stone?
fact: David became Israel's greatest king and wrote many of the Psalms.

clue: What kind of wood did Noah use to build the Ark commanded by God?
fact: God instructed Noah to make rooms in the ark and cover it with pitch inside and out.

clue: Who was thrown into the den of lions but was saved by an angel of God?
fact: Daniel prayed three times a day toward Jerusalem despite the king's decree.

clue: In which river was Jesus baptized by John the Baptist?
fact: When Jesus came up out of the water, the Spirit of God descended like a dove upon Him.

clue: Who was the promised son born to Abraham and Sarah in their old age?
fact: The name Isaac means 'laughter' because both Abraham and Sarah laughed at God's promise.

clue: Which brave queen fasted for three days and risked her life to save the Jewish people?
fact: Esther famously declared, 'If I perish, I perish,' before approaching King Ahasuerus.

clue: Which prophet was taken up to heaven in a whirlwind with a chariot of fire?
fact: Elijah did not experience physical death on earth; God took him directly to heaven.

clue: On which holy mountain did God give Moses the Ten Commandments?
fact: Mount Sinai was covered in smoke because the Lord descended upon it in fire.

clue: Which city's walls fell down flat after the Israelites marched around it for seven days?
fact: When the trumpets sounded and the people shouted, the walls of Jericho collapsed.

clue: Which disciple walked on water toward Jesus but began to sink when he saw the wind?
fact: Jesus reached out His hand and caught Peter, saying, 'O you of little faith, why did you doubt?'

clue: Which prophet spent three days and three nights in the belly of a great fish?
fact: Jonah prayed from inside the fish, and the Lord commanded the fish to vomit him onto dry land.

clue: What is the Aramaic name for the Place of a Skull where Jesus was crucified?
fact: Golgotha is located outside the city walls of ancient Jerusalem.

clue: Who was the strongest judge of Israel whose secret strength lay in his uncut hair?
fact: Samson was a Nazirite from birth, dedicated to God with a vow never to cut his hair.

clue: Which disciple betrayed Jesus Christ for thirty pieces of silver?
fact: Judas Iscariot identified Jesus to the chief priests with a kiss in the Garden of Gethsemane.

clue: Which disciple doubted Jesus' resurrection until he saw the nail marks in His hands?
fact: When Jesus appeared, Thomas exclaimed, 'My Lord and my God!'

clue: Who was the wisest king of Israel who built the first holy Temple in Jerusalem?
fact: When God asked what Solomon desired, he chose wisdom to govern God's people justly.

clue: Who was the first person to see the risen Jesus Christ on Easter morning?
fact: Mary Magdalene stood weeping outside the empty tomb before Jesus called her by name.

clue: Which prophet wrote extensively about the Messiah as the Suffering Servant?
fact: Isaiah prophesied that the Messiah would be wounded for our transgressions.

clue: What was the original Hebrew name of the Apostle Paul before his conversion on the Damascus road?
fact: Saul saw a blinding light from heaven and heard Jesus say, 'Why do you persecute Me?'

clue: Which Moabite woman famously said to Naomi, 'Your people shall be my people, and your God my God'?
fact: Ruth married Boaz in Bethlehem and became the great-grandmother of King David.

clue: Who walked faithfully with God for 300 years and was taken to heaven without dying?
fact: The Bible says Enoch walked with God, and he was not, for God took him.

clue: Who was the father of Joseph who gave him a coat of many colors?
fact: God changed Jacob's name to Israel after he wrestled with an angel at Peniel.

clue: On which mountain range did Noah's Ark come to rest after the Great Flood?
fact: The ark rested on the mountains of Ararat on the seventeenth day of the seventh month.
